content:
song_mood: "One LLM-authored primitive: the swarm forms a double helix, then spins it about its axis."
choreography_plan: "double_helix forms the shape once. Every later key rotates the formed helix about z, which preserves every radius and height so the formation cannot collide with itself while it turns."
choreography:
  s1b1t1: double_helix(0.9, 1.1, 0.5)
  s1b5t1: rotate(90, 'z')
  s2b1t1: rotate(90, 'z')
  s2b5t1: rotate(90, 'z')
  s3b1t1: rotate(90, 'z')
  END
lighting:
  s1b1t1: light_color(['all', []], 'cyan', 'both')
  END
